name: turtl-core-rs-wasm-crypto
description: npm deps for the wasm32 real-libsodium.js crypto bridge (src/crypto/low.rs's wasm_bridge, js/sodium_bridge.js) and its wasm-bindgen-test suite. The *sumo* build is required: only it has scrypt (native gen_key), the explicit SHA functions, and Argon2. See docs/wasm-port-plan.md decision 2.1 and Step 4b-5.
